pre.speaker: narrator
pre.text: Zhuo County, in the last cold weeks of winter. A notice has been nailed to the gatepost: the Yellow Turbans are up in half the provinces, and every district must raise men to meet them.

pre.speaker: liu-bei
pre.text: I have read it three times and I get the same answer each time. The Han is coming apart, and I am standing here sighing at a wall.

pre.speaker: zhang-fei
pre.text: Then stop sighing at the wall and come to my farm. I have a cellar of wine, a pig that is asking to be eaten, and a whole orchard of peach trees in bloom behind the barn.

pre.speaker: guan-yu
pre.text: I am Guan Yu. I came to see who is signing up men here. If it is to guard the people and not to fatten a purse, put my name beside yours.

pre.speaker: liu-bei
pre.text: Then let us say it under the trees. We were born in three houses, on three different days. We ask only that Heaven let us die on the same one.

pre.speaker: zhang-fei
pre.text: A brother to two men I met this week. Fine. I have done stupider things, and most of them were this morning.

pre.speaker: guan-yu
pre.text: Three men and a barn of grain do not make an army. Where are the soldiers?

pre.speaker: narrator
pre.text: By morning there are three hundred volunteers at Zhang Fei's gate, and a smith has been told to forge a pair of long weapons. Magistrate Zou Jing is marching out to meet the rebels at Daxing Hill, and the brothers go with him.
